Hostinger staging, Founder, production, exact deployed parity, live DB/schema, migration state and operational acceptance remain separate unverified gates.

requirements.source: File 25 sections 25-28 as superseded by current central/File 20 ownership addenda
requirements.summary: File 25 owns canonical visual tokens and visual regression with Sabri Green #087A4E; File 20 retains structural shell widths, layout breakpoints, shell dimensions and mount geometry.

Founder/profile presentation routes, section routing, 404/410 boundaries and REST slug validation are implemented; File 03 UUID/public-ID versus File 25 slug canonical-alias parity remains an external staging acceptance gate.

Founder, verified Doctor and permitted Member presentation, hero, current File 03 1.4.0 public-media URL/alt projection, sections, native-owner actions and owner-only View-as-Public are implemented from authorized projections. Preview modes public/member/mobile/desktop/contact/search/social remain noindex projection-only surfaces and suppress owner/viewer-mutating actions; unavailable native actions hide rather than guess routes.

Federated read-only timeline eligibility, author binding, chronology/pinning, filters/search, bounded admin-governed page size, pagination, truncation, duplicate suppression and browser-Back scroll restoration are implemented; File 21 remains the canonical publication/ProfileTimeline bridge.

Reusable content/profile cards, public field allow-lists, safe destinations/media, Read More behavior, card variants and profile-local discovery presentation are implemented without native domain writes.
Loading, empty, warning, offline, error, suspended, deleted, corrected and retracted presentation states are represented without inventing native owner decisions.

requirements.source: File 25 sections 59-61 and Master Plan P-11
requirements.summary: Mobile-first responsive source, visible keyboard focus, touch-sized controls, RTL-aware presentation, reduced-motion and forced-colors preparation are implemented; real-device/browser evidence remains a separate acceptance gate.

Bounded provider queries, pagination, fail-closed optional providers, no-store sensitive output, deterministic ETag/Last-Modified conditional reads and bounded public REST rate limiting are implemented.

requirements.source: File 25 section 64 and current File 24 governance boundary
requirements.summary: File 25 enforces secure rendering, same-site URLs and bounded module metadata while current File 24 remains security/privacy/compliance/resilience owner; advisory state requests do not grant File 25 security authority.

Canonical SEO presentation, privacy-safe public metrics and owner-only profile completion assistance are implemented. Completion assistance exposes native edit plus governed public/mobile/search/contact/social preview destinations without editing File 00/File 03 truth directly; preview itself suppresses owner controls.

Governed File 25 presentation preferences include active profile template, bounded timeline page size, section/density/focal/search/metrics controls and safe operations. profile_template now has observable token-based standard/compact/institutional behavior; File 20 remains shell/layout owner.

Versioned public REST and component APIs use strict allow-lists, bounded pagination, permission callbacks, ETag/Last-Modified conditional reads, bounded public rate limiting, no private identifiers and sanitized component rendering.
Provider health, System Check, Safe Mode, diagnostics, staging preflight and bounded File25-only repair behaviors are implemented without mutating foreign native domain data.
Schema upgrades are idempotent with stale-lock recovery, current companion structural contracts are verified, and uninstall remains non-destructive to native profiles/posts/domain data.

Role, profile-state, timeline-state, security, accessibility, companion-contract and adversarial source-level QA is governed through Reviews 20-594, including the fifth fresh eighty-round current-truth cycle.

Visual-regression/browser/accessibility contracts and evidence schema are prepared; real browser/device, zoom, RTL/LTR, keyboard/touch/screen-reader and cross-module screenshot evidence remains pending on Hostinger staging.
Deterministic ZIP construction, manifest, checksum, exact current dependency matrix, duplicate/symlink/path/expansion defenses and independent artifact verification are implemented.
